LISTENING: A FASHION SHOW

5th grade · A2 practice · Listen, choose, write and improve.

🎯 Your mission

Listen to three friends. They are planning a fashion show. Choose seven answers. Then answer three questions using Present Continuous.

Ayuda: Escucha primero para entender la idea general. Luego responde las preguntas. En la parte escrita, usa Present Continuous para explicar qué están organizando y describir la ropa del ejemplo. Revisa el feedback y corrige antes de descargar.

Time: about 15 minutes. You can pause and replay the audio as often as you need.

🎧 Listen

Three students are organizing a fashion show. Listen for their roles and the example describing clothes.

1. Listen and choose

Choose one answer for each question. / Elige una respuesta por pregunta.

2. Answer using Present Continuous

Write complete answers. For question C, write “No, they aren’t.” and one sentence about their plan. / En C, escribe la respuesta corta negativa y una oración sobre lo que están planificando.

🧱 Present Continuous / Ayuda

They are + verb-ing. Example: They are preparing a poster.
He is + verb-ing. Example: He is wearing a jacket.
Short answers: Yes, they are. / No, they aren’t.

En el audio están planificando el desfile. La descripción de la ropa de Mo es un ejemplo del comentario que pueden preparar.
